text: CONTRADICTING: Under basal conditions, E4/E4 iMGs showed lower intracellular pHrodo-dextran fluorescence over 20 h than E3/E3 iMGs, and at 3 h. The authors interpret this as reduced pinocytosis. Because pHrodo signal depends on both uptake and compartment acidity, it does not show the increased endosomal acidification predicted for APOE4; if anything, the signal is lower.
description: Human iPSC-derived microglia-like cells (iMGs), APOE3/3 vs APOE4/4 lines (not isogenic overall). Cells were incubated with pHrodo Red/Green 10 kDa dextran (16.7-20 µg/ml) and imaged in an IncuCyte live imaging system for 20 h. The unit is the iPSC line (mean of 1-3 independent experiments). Caveat: microglia, not astrocytes. pHrodo signal conflates uptake with acidification, and no pH calibration was done.

provenance.excerpt: Under basal conditions, pinocytosis was significantly reduced in E4/E4 iMGs compared to E3/E3 iMGs (two-way repeated measures ANOVA, time x genotype p=0.01; Fig. 1J, L).

meccogFinding.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (lower pHrodo-dextran signal in endo-lysosomal compartments of microglia; interpreted as reduced pinocytosis) [CONTRADICTS]

perturbed.variable: APOE4/4 vs APOE3/3 genotype of iPSC-derived microglia

measured.variable: Intracellular pHrodo-dextran (10 kDa) fluorescence normalized to confluence. The signal rises with uptake into acidified endo-lysosomal compartments.
